packageRules.description: Gradle runs on a separate build JVM, but tests still run on JDK 11, 17, and 19. JUnit 6+ requires Java 17 at test runtime, so keep JUnit major updates blocked while JDK 11 tests are required.
CI and publication run Gradle 9 on a separate LTS build JDK. Allow current and future LTS releases identified by Adoptium's LTS suffix, excluding short-lived non-LTS runtimes.
JDK 11 is the compilation toolchain and a required test runtime, not the Gradle build JVM. Keep its major version to preserve Java 11 compatibility while allowing LTS build JDK updates.
